widgets_values: Style: Realistic cinematic feel. The woman slowly moved a red embroidered round fan away from her face, revealing her dignified expression and deep red lips. As she lowered the fan to her chest, the camera gradually zoomed out, fully revealing her upper body and the intricate golden floral patterns on the red velvet dress. She said in a soft and rhythmic voice in Chinese, "我是通过LTX二点三首尾帧工作流制作的，还行吗？"
